mapper.select: WITH university_boundary AS ( SELECT ST_Union(ST_Buffer(boundary, 0.005)) AS merged_geometry FROM public.land_plot WHERE address LIKE '%' || #{location} || '%' AND land_area > 0 ) SELECT ST_AsText( ST_Simplify( ST_Envelope(merged_geometry), 0.0001 ) ) AS university_boundary_wkt FROM university_boundary
SELECT ST_AsText(ST_ForcePolygonCCW(boundary)) AS polygon_wkt FROM public.land_plot WHERE address LIKE '%' || #{location} || '%' AND ST_GeometryType(boundary) = 'ST_Polygon'
SELECT id, ST_X(center_point::geometry) AS latitude, ST_Y(center_point::geometry) AS longitude, land_area AS weight FROM public.land_plot WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND center_point IS NOT NULL
